answer: In an atlas of timber yards and garden suppliers, agents can earn service fees only against customer vouchers backed by completed purchases. Each voucher is consumed once, and rewards stay below the nonrefundable external cost of generating that purchase. Accounts sharing a voucher gain no extra payout. Independent delivery audits reduce fake orders. A Sybil operator must buy additional verified deliveries for each claim; if those costs exceed rewards, multiplying identities loses money.
